meta.basis: The priest gives the Homily 'standing at the chair or at the ambo itself or, if appropriate, in another worthy place' (GIRM 136): here a pulpit, which keeps the card apart from the ambo of the readings. The faithful sit for the Homily (GIRM 43); it is given by the priest celebrant himself (GIRM 66). The excerpt is Christ's own first homily, at Nazareth, from the Gospel of the Third Sunday, Year C.
